deadline.value: Graduate applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, with no set deadline.
deadline.quote: For Clarkson University's programs, there are no set deadlines for graduate admissions. Instead, we review applications on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional; applicants are advised to submit scores if they will help.

supervisor.value: Name two or three faculty members in your statement of purpose.
supervisor.quote: In your statement, please mention two or three faculty members who you believe would be good advisors/supervisors based on their research areas.

funding.value: TA and RA posts include a stipend and full tuition, but the page does not say how many students hold one.
funding.quote: Teaching Assistantships (TAs) provide a stipend plus full tuition.

entry_route.value: A four-year degree in biology or a relevant science is the prerequisite.
entry_route.quote: Possess a baccalaureate (four-year) degree in biology or a relevant science (e.g., biochemistry, biophysics, environmental science).
